source_notes: Ditto health checklist + IRDAI Protection of Policyholders Interests Regulations 2024 + IRDAI FY2024-25 insurer data

rules.explain_template: A co-pay above {threshold}% means you pay that share of EVERY claim out of pocket. A {threshold}% co-pay on a ₹5L claim is ₹1L from your pocket.
rules.action_template: Ask the insurer for a no-co-pay variant, or compare alternatives before renewing.

rules.explain_template: A room-rent cap under ₹{threshold}/day confines you to a shared ward; the room cost then eats a large share of your sum insured on a multi-day stay.
rules.action_template: Check whether a higher room-rent tier is worth the extra premium.

rules.check: sub-limits on common procedures (ICU, c-section, cataract, dialysis)
rules.explain_template: Sub-limits cap how much the insurer pays for common treatments like ICU stays, c-sections, cataract surgery, or dialysis — even if your sum insured is large.
rules.action_template: Read the sub-limit schedule carefully; these are the treatments families most often claim.

rules.explain_template: Pre & post-hospitalization cover pays for diagnostic tests before admission and medication after discharge. Below {threshold} days, you pay more of these costs yourself.
rules.action_template: Prefer a policy covering at least 30 days pre and 90 days post hospitalization.

rules.explain_template: A pre-existing disease waiting period above {threshold} years means diabetes, BP, or thyroid claims are not covered until that time has passed.
rules.action_template: Confirm exactly when your pre-existing conditions become coverable.

rules.explain_template: An accident waiting period above {threshold} days delays coverage for accident-related claims.
rules.action_template: Prefer a policy with the shortest accident waiting period.

rules.explain_template: Daycare treatments (chemotherapy, dialysis, appendectomy) don't require a 24-hour stay. If not covered, these common procedures are not payable.
rules.action_template: Verify daycare coverage for chemo, dialysis, and appendectomies specifically.

rules.check: sum insured restoration after a claim
rules.explain_template: Without restoration, once your sum insured is used up by one claim, further claims in the same year are not covered.
rules.action_template: Prefer a policy that restores the sum insured at least once per year.

rules.explain_template: A cashless network under {threshold} hospitals makes it harder to find cashless treatment near you.
rules.action_template: Check the network covers hospitals in your city.

rules.explain_template: An ICR between 50% and 80% is healthy. Below 50% may signal strict claim approvals; above ~95% can strain the insurer's long-term stability.
rules.action_template: Compare the insurer's ICR trend over 3 years, not a single year.
rules.source: Ditto ICR guide / IRDAI annual reports

rules.explain_template: You have a {threshold}-day free-look window from receiving the policy document to cancel and get a full refund.
rules.action_template: If the policy is recent, decide within the free-look window.
